title: Plot Binding — Booker Plot → Representative Polti Situations (genre ↔ conflict)
tier_note: Binds high-level genre to concrete conflict templates: each Booker plot suggests the Polti situations that typically instantiate it. Priors used to seed encounter selection; not exclusive. ADR-0022 Phase S2 adds a parallel `polti_situation_weights` array (permille, `0..=1000`); all entries are currently `1000` (all-FULL), so weighted selection is behaviorally uniform until real scholarship weights are authored.

items.name: Overcoming the Monster
items.description: Deliverance, daring enterprise, and conflict with a god/great power.

items.name: Rags to Riches
items.description: Obtaining, rivalry of superior and inferior, and ambition.

items.name: The Quest
items.description: Daring enterprise, the enigma, and recovery of a lost one.

items.name: Voyage and Return
items.description: Pursuit, disaster, and abduction into a strange world.

items.name: Comedy
items.description: Obstacles to love, mistaken jealousy, and erroneous judgment resolved.

items.name: Tragedy

items.name: Rebirth
items.description: Madness, self-sacrifice for an ideal, and remorse leading to renewal.
